Class ShaderAttributeValue

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.NodeComponent
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.ShaderAttribute
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.ShaderAttributeObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.ShaderAttributeValue
All Implemented Interfaces:
NodeComponentWrapper, SceneGraphObjectWrapper, ShaderAttributeObjectWrapper, ShaderAttributeValueWrapper, ShaderAttributeWrapper
public class ShaderAttributeValue extends ShaderAttributeObject implements ShaderAttributeValueWrapper
j3dwrapper delegate for the sg facade's ShaderAttributeValue: a single (attrName, value) uniform. The raw jogamp ShaderAttributeValue requires both the name and an initial value in its constructor, so - exactly like SourceCodeShader - wrapped is built in this constructor (which has the args) and createWrapped() is a no-op (it runs from the base constructor, before the args exist).
